summary: Normalized trial rows must expose the registry's first-posted (registration) date as first_posted, which requires StudyFirstPostDate in the shared CT.gov field request.
reason: CT.gov only returns fields named in the `fields` parameter, and downstream citations (Vancouver/NLM, WHO) identify a register record by its registration date; start_date is a wrong substitute and yields future years for not-yet-started trials. first_posted is omitempty so an absent date stays absent.
validated_outcome: Live NCT01698112 returns protocolSection.statusModule.studyFirstPostDateStruct.date = 2012-10-02 when StudyFirstPostDate is requested.
